name: Being Whole
overview: Scripture reveals that true wholeness is found in God, who strengthens the heart even when our flesh and spirit fail, as seen in Psalms 73:26. From before our formation, God has ordained and sanctified His people for a purpose (Jeremiah 1:5), and through faith in Christ, believers receive the privilege to become children of God (John 1:12). This wholeness is further expressed in the calling to bear lasting fruit by His appointment (John 15:16) and is sustained by the peace Christ provides amid worldly trials, having overcome the world (John 16:33). Ultimately, the Word of God penetrates deeply into our being, discerning the thoughts and intents of the heart, guiding us toward spiritual completeness (Hebrews 4:12).
